node.statement: Local halo partition and mass identity: with H_j=dist_1(p_j,C), G={j:H_j>tau/4}, B={j:0<H_j<=tau/4}, and Z={j:H_j=0}, nonnegativity of distances gives the disjoint partition {j:notin G}=B union Z. By def-invisible-mass, sigma is the sum of a_j^+ over rows with H_j>0, while the contract defines sigma_g as the sum of a_j^+ over rows with H_j>tau/4, i.e. over G. Since {H_j>0}=G union B disjointly, sigma=sum_{j in G}a_j^+ + sum_{j in B}a_j^+ and sigma_g=sum_{j in G}a_j^+; hence sum_{j in B}a_j^+=sigma-sigma_g. The definitions of B and Z also give H_j<=tau/4 on B and H_j=0 on Z.
